Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this game! England seal the series with one game to spare and they will look to make it 3-0 in the last game. Australia, on the other hand, have a lot to think about as they went down quite easily in this game. They have a lot to play for in the third and final T20I as they will maintain their first position in the rankings if they win that. The final T20I will be played on 8th September, 2020, at 1800 local (1700 GMT). Join us for that game. Until then, cheers and take care.

Jos Buttler, the MAN OF THE MATCH, says that opening position is the best position to bat in T20Is. Adds that bowlers did half the job for them. States that Archer's first over was fantastic and put Australia under pressure. Says the partnership with Malan was good and that took the pressure off. States that every time Malan has got an opportunity, he has played brilliantly. States that he was very keen to finish things off as the pitch was tricky and a new batsman would find it hard on this pitch.

Eoin Morgan, the England skipper, says that it was a comprehensive performance. Adds that they bowled pretty well and picking up those wickets in the Powerplay made things easy for them. States that the wicket was soft and that was the reason that they wanted to bowl first anyway. Says that Archer set the tone in the first over. States that Buttler with the kind of form he is in, it makes any target look easy. Says that they will continue to look at options for the opening position. Says that his fingers are a little sore and will have a look at in a couple of days. Goes onto say that they will play the best eleven in the final T20I.

Aaron Finch, the Australian skipper, says that they were a few runs short and they failed to pick up some wickets in the Powerplay. Adds that they did not expect it to seam and it got a bit slow towards the end as well. Adds that if they had got a few early wickets, they could have put England in trouble. States that Buttler played really and hit even the good balls over the park. Adds that he felt that spin was the hardest to hit and that's why he went with the spinners at the end.

Earlier in the day, Australia won the toss and decided to field here. They got off to the worst start as David Warner was back in the hut in just the third ball of the innings courtesy of Archer. They pushed Carey up the order but he was back in the pavilion in the second over itself. Steve Smith also was run out by a brilliant throw by Eoin Morgan. Aaron Finch and Marcus Stoinis did well to stitch a partnership but then Finch was walking back shortly after as well. They did well to score 40 runs off the last 3 overs to cross 150 but still would be disappointed with that start. The bowling by the hosts was very admirable as a whole and Morgan would be very happy with the bowling as they have struggled a bit with the ball. With this victory, England have wrapped up the series with a 2-0 victory and will be looking to whitewash their counterparts in the final T20I which is coming up in 2 days time. But before that, we have the presentation ceremony coming up, so stick around with us to hear what the captains have to say!

What a great game of cricket we have had here! England looked like they would wrap up this match and series with ease, but struggled towards the end there as they lost wickets at crucial moments and it looked like they would collapse like how Australia did in the first T20I but England held on and Jos Buttler was the star of the show as he scored a very well made 77 runs on the way to their victory. Dawid Malan too, continued his brilliant form scoring 42 runs before departing. Moeen Ali scored 10 runs off 2 balls in the 19th over making sure England would finish this game and win the series 2-0. The bowling by Australia was not bad at all, but the batters performed well and the bowlers could not break the partnerships down going into the final overs.

SIX! Yes, Buttler absolutely can! What a shot to finish the match and seal the series with one game to spare! Looped up ball on off, Buttler puts on his dancing shoes and lifts it over the bowler's head for a biggie. ENGLAND WIN BY 6 WICKETS.
Tossed up ball outside off, Ali drives it to deep cover for a single. 6 needed. Can Buttler finish with a six?
FOUR! 10 from the last two balls! 7 required from 9 now. This should be easy for England! Flighted ball on off, Ali dances down the track and lifts it over the extra cover fielder for a boundary.
SIX! Excellent use of the feet! Moeen Ali is a lovely player of spin! That will release some pressure! Flighted outside off, Ali uses his feet and powers it over long off for a maximum.
Flatter one outside off, Buttler cuts it to deep point for a single.
Loopy around off, Buttler works this one towards long off for one more run. England need 18 in 12 balls.
Loopy outside off, Ali works this one through the point region for one run.
Flighted around middle, Ali defends this towards the leg side.
Loopy around middle and leg, Jos works this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, cut towards the deep point region for a single.
Flatter outside off, cut towards the backward point region for a single.
Moeen Ali is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! There is no doubt about this one as Morgan has hit it straight to Maxwell. Morgan is dejected as he knows that he has given Australia a chance now. This is the almost the same way that Maxwell got out in the last game and Morgan does it here! Zampa bowls a flighted ball outside off, Morgan drives it uppishly towards cover. Maxwell hops and takes a sharp catch. 23 still needed from 18 deliveries.

NOT OUT! The wickets is missing and Australia lose all their reviews. Flighted ball around off, Morgan looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. Finch takes the review. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that it is missing the off stump.
Aaron Finch takes the review for LBW! Let's see what happens.
FOUR! SMASHED! Flighted ball on middle, Morgan hammers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Tosses this on the pads, Buttler flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Pierces the gap! It was uppish for a while but wide of the fielder! Floated outside off, Buttler punches it through extra cover for a boundary. 28 needed from 22.
Flighted on middle, Morgan looks to play the reverse but it takes the top edge and goes towards short third man. A single taken.
Adam Zampa is back on. 2-0-14-0 are his figures so far.
Loopy ball around middle, Buttler looks to sweep and plays it to the leg side and sets off for the run but Morgan sends him back. An appeal for LBW but the umpire does not seem to think so.
Loopy around middle and leg, Morgan flicks this one towards the short fine leg area for one run.
Tossed up around middle, Buttler works this one towards short fine leg for another single.
Flatter around leg, Morgan tucks it away to the leg side for a single.
Eoin Morgan, the skipper, comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Is this the point where Australia come into the game and snatch it up from England? The signs are positive as they scalp another wicket now removing Banton on the cheap. Floated ball around middle, Banton sweeps this one uppishly towards the deep square leg area and Cummins does well to catch this one. This was a very loose shot by Banton and he will be disappointed with himself for the same!
Flatter around off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Tom works it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball outside off, Banton punches it through the cover-point region and picks up a couple.
LEG BYE! Good length ball on the pads, Buttler looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batter pick up a leg bye.
WIDE! Short ball around middle, Buttler looks to pull but misses. Wide given.
Starc bowls a full delivery on off, Jos drives it straight to cover.
Good length ball on off, Buttler pushes it to cover.
Good length ball on middle, Buttler flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
Mitchell Starc will finish his quota.
On off, Banton does well to keep this one out. 43 required off the last 36 balls.
Quicker delivery, pushed towards long off for one run.

FOUR! Buttler wants to wrap this one early by the looks of it! Great shot by Jos here! England getting closer to winning the tie! Floated around middle, Buttler reverse sweeps this one past the fielder at point for four more runs.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR BUTTLER! Floated outside off, Buttler plays this towards the deep cover region and will get four runs even though Stoinis tried to stop this one. Great innings by Jos! Will he take them home this evening?
Tom Banton makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Australia strike here finally after being put on the back foot by these two! Can Australia do what England did the other night and stage a comeback? Floated around middle and off, Malan sweeps this towards the cow cover region on the up and Stoinis does well to catch this one without any trouble.
Floated outside off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Short ball on middle, Buttler pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Moves to 48.
FOUR! Poor delivery and it has been dealt away! Short ball on middle, Buttler pulls it to deep square leg. The fielder comes across, slides to make a stop but fails to do so and it crosses the fence.
Good length ball on off, Buttler defends it to point.
Full ball on middle, Dawid flicks it to deep square leg for a single. 100 up. Need more 58.
FOUR! That is some shot! Malan moves into the 40s! England are doing it easily! Fullish ball outside off, Malan drives it over the cover fielder and into the fence.
Back of a length outside off, Buttler drives it to deep cover for a single.
Pat Cummins is back on. 2-0-13-0, his figures so far.
Flatter ball around off, Agar works this to long off for one more run to end the over.
Tossed up around middle, Malan tucks this to the leg side for one run.
Flatter around middle, Malan comes down the track and it hits him on the pads.
Floated around off, pushed towards the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Reverse Sweeps are raining here by these two! Floated around middle and off, Jos reverse sweeps this past the fielder at backward point for four runs.
Flatter around leg, Malan looks to reverse sweep but doesn't connect this one in the middle as the ball goes towards the point region for a single.
Ashton Agar is into the attack.
Good length ball on middle, Buttler flicks it deep square leg for another couple. 12 from the over. 72 required from 9 overs.
FOUR! That is a beautiful shot from Buttler! Full delivery outside off, Buttler drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Buttler pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Fullish ball outside off, Buttler creams the drive through extra cover and picks up an easy couple.
Short ball on the pads, Malan pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Good length ball on off, Buttler pushes it to point for a single.
Kane Richardson is back on. 1-0-7-0 are his figures so far.
A googly to end the over, Malan pushes this towards the cover region.
Floated on middle, Malan works this back towards Zampa.
On middle, pushed towards long off for a single.
Flighted outside off, Malan works this through to the third man for a single.

FOUR! Another one! England turning it up here in the past two overs with some boundaries! Tossed up around off, Malan plays this on the up over the fielder at mid on for a four. 50-run partnership up for these two here!
FOUR! Innovation at the fore here from Malan! Tossed up around off, Malan reverse sweeps this one past the fielder at short third man for four runs.
Floated on middle, Malan drives it to long off for a single. 11 from the over. 94 needed from 66 balls.
Outside off, punched to long off for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Malan looks to flick but it takes the leading edge which goes the off side. A single taken.
BEATEN! Good comeback from Maxwell! Loopy ball outside off, Malan looks to defend but misses.
FOUR! Brilliant from Malan! Good start to the over! Short ball outside off, Malan rocks on his back foot and cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
FOUR! Innovation time! Flighted on middle, Malan goes on his knees and then reverse sweeps it towards deep point. Agar comes across and fails to stop it. Four signalled.
Flighted around off, Malan pushes this towards long on for one run.
A googly this time, Malan pushes this towards short third man.
Tossed up outside off, takes the outside edge off Buttler's bat towards the third man for a single.
Floated around off, Malan sweeps this one towards deep mid-wicket for one run.
Flatter around middle and leg, Jos comes down the track a touch and flicks this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated around middle, Buttler comes down the track and plays this one back towards the bowler and the pads of Malan stop the ball before it reaches down the ground.
Adam Zampa is into the attack.
Short on middle, Buttler pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter one outside off, Buttler punches it to cover.
Excellent running! Loopy ball on middle, Buttler flicks it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a couple before the fielder cleans it up.
Quicker one on middle, Malan tucks it to deep square leg for another run.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter one outside off, Buttler pushes it to cover.
Glenn Maxwell comes into bowl.

FOUR! Not planned by Malan but he will accept this one! On a good length around off, Malan looks to work this one but it takes an inside edge and runs past the fielder at short fine leg for four runs. England are at 44/1 at the end of 6 overs.
A fullish length ball outside off, Malan smacks this on the ground and the fielder at cover collects this one.
WIDE! The umpire signals wide as this short delivery was over the off and middle stump.
Back of a good length around off, Malan looks to pull but misses and it hits him on his thigh pad.
Pat is not punished as he bowled this full toss outside off, Buttler plays this on the stretch towards the point region for a single.
A full delivery outside off, Buttler pushes this to the fielder at cover.
Back of a good length outside off, Malan opens up the face of this bat and works this fine towards the man at third man for a single.
Pat Cummins is back on. His first over cost just 6 runs.
FOUR! Poor ball to end! Unusual shot but it fetches him a boundary! Short ball down the leg side, Buttler plays with one hand past the short fine leg fielder and into the fence.
Fullish ball on middle, Malan flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away nicely! Did not time it well but it has enough to reach the fence! Short ball on middle, Malan pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Malan looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
Half an appeal! Short ball on middle, Malan looks to pull but misses. It goes off his thigh pad to Carey. There is an appeal for caught behind but nothing from the umpire.
Back of a length ball on middle, Dawid solidly blocks it to the off side.
Good length ball on off, Malan pushes it to point.

SIX! Jos plays this one fine and will end the over on a high! On a good length around off and middle, Buttler hits this on the up towards the deep mid-wicket region and will get a maximum here as it bounces right on the rope. Jos does not let Richardson end the over on a good note with this maximum!
Good length around middle and leg, Jos flicks this towards mid-wicket but will find the fielder again. Pressure building on England with all these dot balls!
Kane dishes this out back of a length around off, Jos fends this back towards the bowler.
Short of a good length ball around off, Buttler cuts this towards point but will find the fielder.
Back of a good length outside off, Buttler pushes this towards point.
Good length ball around leg, Malan works this one towards mid-wicket where Warner does well to half-stop this one as the batters will get one run.
Malan is off the mark! Full delivery on the pads, Malan flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Dawid Malan is the next man in.

OUT! HIT-WICKET! Has Bairstow been dismissed Hit-Wicket? Yes, he has been as his bat has clipped the bails as it was coming down. A really unfortunate way to get out but Bairstow has to go. Jonny cannot believe that he has done that and disappointingly walks back to the hut. Not a conventional way to pick up a wicket but Australia will take it. Starc bowls a short one outside off, Bairstow looks to pull at first but then decides to get his bat away. In doing so, Bairstow mistakenly dislodges the bails with his bat. Bairstow's poor form continues.
Slower full toss on off, Jonny pushes it to cover.
Good length ball outside off, Bairstow looks to drive but it takes the inside edge and it goes towards mid on.
FOUR! Same result! This is excellent cricket from Bairstow! Fullish ball on middle, Bairstow drives it past the bowler and into the fence for another boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Good length ball outside off, Bairstow lifts it over mid off and the ball races to the fence.

A yorker around middle and leg, Buttler looks to fend this one out but misses and the players go up in appeal but the umpire looks pensive and says no as it looked like it was heading down leg. Finch doesn't go for the review this time around.

FOUR! What a classy stroke by Jos here! He is continuing where he left off in the previous match! On a good length around off and middle, Buttler moves to his left and drives this one through the cover region for four runs.
An appeal for run out has been taken upstairs. It looks like Buttler was in and the replays confirm the same!

NOT OUT! Buttler was in! On a good length around off, Bairstow pushes this towards the point region and they will run for the single. Maxwell throws this and it hits the wickets. The on-field umpire goes to the third umpire and replays show that he was well in.
Back of a length ball around middle and leg, Buttler pulls this hard towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
EDGED BUT SHORT! On a good length outside off, Buttler looks to push this towards the off side but it nips his outside edge and drops just short of the first slip there.
Back of a good length around off, Buttler plays it back towards Cummins.
Pat Cummins will bowl from the other end.
FOUR LEG BYES! Decent start from Starc but it ends with a boundary! Good length ball on the pads, Bairstow looks to flick but it goes off his pads and towards the fine leg region for a boundary.
Fullish ball on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Good length ball on the pads, Bairstow looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Full delivery outside off, Bairstow drives it to mid off.

NOT OUT! Missing the stumps and Australia have lost one review! Starc bowls a good length ball on middle, shaping in. Bairstow looks to flick but gets rapped on the pads. Australia appeal but the umpire is not interested. Finch takes the review. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that it is missing the leg stump.
Australia have taken the review for LBW! It looks like it is going down leg. Let's see what happens.
ENGLAND ARE UNDERWAY! Starc starts with a good length ball on middle, Buttler works it to square leg for a single.
We are back for the chase! The Aussies stride out to the middle, followed by Jonny Bairstow and Jos Buttler. Mitchell Starc will start with the ball.
